blocks.explanation:
Question 13 wala hi khayal hai, bas yahan poore angles hain, aadhe nahi.
\(\alpha + \beta = 180^{\circ} - \gamma\) likh kar dono sides ka cot lenge.
Plan: right par allied angle, left par cot-sum formula, cross-multiply, phir terms ikatthe.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\alpha + \beta + \gamma = 180^{\circ}\).
Saabit karna hai: \(\cot\alpha\cot\beta + \cot\beta\cot\gamma + \cot\gamma\cot\alpha = 1\).
Tareeqa: \(\cot(\alpha + \beta) = \frac{\cot\alpha\cot\beta - 1}{\cot\alpha + \cot\beta}\) aur \(\cot(180^{\circ} - \gamma) = -\cot\gamma\). Do angles ko teesre angle ki shakal mein likhna aur phir ratio lena, aise sab sawalon ka aam tareeqa hai.

Dono sides ka cot lein
\[\alpha + \beta = 180^{\circ} - \gamma\]
\[\cot(\alpha + \beta) = \cot(180^{\circ} - \gamma) = -\cot\gamma\]
Kyun: \(180^{\circ} - \gamma\) quadrant II mein hai jahan cot negative hota hai. \(180^{\circ}\) even multiple of \(90^{\circ}\) hai, is liye ratio nahi badalta, cot hi rehta hai, sirf sign minus.

Left side kholein
\[\dfrac{\cot\alpha\cot\beta - 1}{\cot\alpha + \cot\beta} = -\cot\gamma\]
Kyun: Question 6(i) wala cot-sum formula.

Cross-multiply karein
\[\cot\alpha\cot\beta - 1 = -\cot\gamma\cot\alpha - \cot\gamma\cot\beta\]
Kyun: Dono sides ko \(\cot\alpha + \cot\beta\) se multiply kiya, phir \(-\cot\gamma\) ko bracket ke dono terms se multiply kiya.
Dhyan dein: Minus sign dono terms tak jata hai; sirf pehle term ko minus dena aam ghalti hai.

Products ek taraf karein
\[\cot\alpha\cot\beta + \cot\beta\cot\gamma + \cot\gamma\cot\alpha = 1\]
Kyun: Dono products ko left par le aaye (sign plus ho gaya) aur \(-1\) ko right par (plus 1). \(\cot\gamma\cot\beta\) aur \(\cot\beta\cot\gamma\) ek hi cheez hain.

Tasdeeq, har angle \(60^{\circ}\)
\[3\left(\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^2 = 3 \cdot \dfrac{1}{3} = 1 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\cot 60^{\circ} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\); teeno products \(\frac{1}{3}\) hain aur jama 1.
